agency.name: Behavioral Health Services Division (BHSD), New Mexico Health Care Authority

narrNote: No New Mexico affiliate appears on NARR's official affiliate list (narronline.org/affiliates, fetched 2026-10-22), and New Mexico has no state recovery-residence certification requirement. The New Mexico Alliance of Recovery Resources (NMARR, formed 2025) describes itself as the state affiliate but is NOT listed in NARR's official directory, so it is not recorded as the affiliate.
notes: BHSD moved from the former Human Services Department to the new New Mexico Health Care Authority (HCA) in the July 1, 2024 state restructure; HCA documents fetched 2026-10-22 define BHSD as the division that 'serves as the adult mental health and substance use authority for the state of New Mexico,' and BHSD works in coordination with the statutorily created New Mexico Behavioral Health Collaborative. The BHSD phone (505) 476-9266 was verified on HCA's official Contact Us page (hca.nm.gov/contact_us, fetched 2026-10-22). NMCAL (1-855-NMCRISIS) is staffed by the same counselors as New Mexico 988, which BHSD operates. UWNCNM operates the state's flagship 211 call center covering nine counties; dialing 2-1-1 is statewide. VERIFICATION CAVEAT: the research fetch service rate-limited (HTTP 429) before the BHSD page and the UWNCNM 211 page could be fetched directly, and those two requests were not repeated per instruction. Both URLs are corroborated by fresh same-day evidence from official sources: the BHSD page was crawled 2026-10-22 under its current title 'Behavioral Health Services Division - New Mexico Health Care Authority' with matching live content, and the 211 URL is UWNCNM's own '211 Free Helpline' page, corroborated by a Santa Fe County news release and SHARE New Mexico's listing. Both are flagged for a one-click re-fetch to complete direct in-run verification. medicaidSud is null: Turquoise Care, HCA's Medicaid managed care program, covers substance-use services (CMS five-year Section 1115 extension includes SUD authority), but no member-facing Medicaid SUD page URL on hca.nm.gov could be verified in this run - no URL was guessed.
